title: SPECIAL EDITION 01 — When Thinking Costs Approach Zero

image.alt: A person types on a laptop in a dark space, representing a world in which rapid calculation and answer production can reshape the measure of achievement.

slides.text:
When the cost of thinking
approaches zero

AI has begun producing answers that once took a long time almost instantly. In September 2026, twenty-five Fields Medalists warned that this speed could change what we count as achievement.

image.alt: Mathematician Maryna Viazovska, one of the declaration's signatories, faces the camera against a gray background.

slides.text:
Twenty-five Fields Medalists
issued a joint declaration

On September 11, 2026, twenty-five Fields Medalists—including Terence Tao, June Huh, and Maryna Viazovska—published a joint declaration.

They did not oppose AI. They challenged a situation in which corporate performance contests could determine what an academic community recognizes as important work.

image.alt: Students in a Helsinki University of Technology lecture hall face a board covered in equations, illustrating an environment where problems can become measures of achievement.

slides.text:
Famous problems became
tests for AI

Long-unsolved problems make convenient tests of a model's ability because whether it solved them and how quickly can be compared as numbers.

The declaration treats difficult problems not as the final purpose of mathematics, but as a __proxy__ for whether new structures were understood and reusable methods were created.

image.alt: Mathematician June Huh, one of the declaration's original signatories, speaks on stage at the 2018 International Congress of Mathematicians.

slides.text:
Problem solving was a proxy,
not the purpose

“Solving problems is only a tool and proxy.”

An answer once served as a milestone showing that understanding had advanced. When that milestone becomes an AI score, __producing more answers__ can displace __understanding and explaining why they are true__.

image.alt: Students sit around a table listening to a presenter by a board, representing the review and teaching through which results become shared knowledge.

slides.text:
What they sought to protect
was larger than the answer

The declaration sought to preserve new understanding and reusable methods, alongside student development and accurate attribution of ideas.

A result does not become shared knowledge merely by being announced. It must be reviewed, simplified, connected to prior work, and explained so the next person can learn from it.

image.alt:
As answers arrive faster,
__which parts of the process__
must we protect more deliberately?

slides.text:
As answers arrive faster,
__which parts of the process__
must we protect more deliberately?

caption.body: In September 2026, twenty-five Fields Medalists did not oppose AI's mathematical ability. They warned that a race for performance could begin to determine the purpose of scholarship itself. Solving famous problems produces an easy benchmark, but the declaration sought to protect a wider ecology of knowledge: new understanding and reusable methods, student development, review and education, and accurate attribution of ideas.
